subject: Dedicated capacity ramp schedule — HelioHealth multi-year prepay discussion
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@heliohealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Saito <mark@heliohealth.com>, HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased ramp for Dedicated GPUs

Connor —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our infra team is comfortable with Redwood’s runtime and we want to discuss a multi-year prepay structure for Dedicated capacity. The high-level ask from procurement: a 3-year committed path with a ramped on-ramp over the first 12 months (we expect to scale from a small pilot to steady 400 vGPU-equivalent TPMs by month 12).

Specific questions from our side:
- Do you support phased GPU/TPM commits that allow us to pay an initial tranche and top up at predefined milestones?
- How do term discounts apply if we ramp faster/slower than the schedule?
- What billing cadence and invoicing flexibility do you offer for multi-year prepays?

We can share a target ramp schedule, but wanted to get your standard options first. Looping Mark on infra and procurement.

Thanks —
Elena Martinez
Head of Cloud Platform
HelioHealth

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Mark Saito <mark@heliohealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased ramp for Dedicated GPUs

Elena —

Great to hear — appreciate the clarity on target scale. Yes, we support phased on-ramps for Dedicated capacity. High-level options we typically propose:

1) Milestone prepay: Yearly prepay with optional in-year top-ups tied to agreed ramp milestones (e.g., Month 0, Month 6, Month 12). Term discount increases with larger prepay and longer commitments.
2) Stepped commitment: Fixed monthly committed TPM/GPU that increases at scheduled dates (billing reflects the higher committed rate after an uplift date).
3) Hybrid: Initial prepay + monthly committed baseline with credits applied as you hit tranche thresholds.

I'll bring Laura (pricing) and Aditya (finance) into the thread to propose a concrete schedule and an initial commercial template. Can you share a simple target ramp table (month -> target TPM/GPU)? If easier, I can send our template.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@heliohealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Saito <mark@heliohealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased ramp for Dedicated GPUs — proposal v1

Hi Elena/Mark —

Following up with a starting commercial construct. I attached a short proposal (redwood-dedicated-ramp-proposal-v1.pdf) and included a compact ramp table below to illustrate tiers and discounts. This is a draft; happy to iterate.

Proposal highlights (draft):
- Term: 3 years with annual prepay option (annual invoices)
- Baseline: Year 1 committed baseline = 150 vGPU-equivalent TPMs (monthly average)
- Ramp tranches: Month 1: 150 -> Month 6: 275 -> Month 12: 400
- Discounting: 10% off list for year 1 annual prepay (on baseline), 14% for year 2 prepay, 18% for year 3 prepay. If Helio hits >=95% of agreed 12-mo target early (by Month 9), an early-ramp bonus discount of additional 2% applied to remaining term.
- Top-ups: Additional capacity purchased mid-year billed at committed rates pro-rated; credits apply toward next-year prepay if purchased within 30 days of tranche achievement.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-ramp-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal), ramp snippet included in body.

Quick ask: can procurement confirm whether Helio needs quarterly invoicing or prefers single annual invoice? We typically do annual prepay by default but can do quarterly invoices mapped to the same committed amount for internal accounting reasons.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Principal, Pricing Strategy | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-ramp-proposal-v1.pdf

From: Mark Saito <mark@heliohealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena@heliohealth.com>, HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased ramp for Dedicated GPUs — counter and questions

Laura/Connor —

Thanks for the quick draft. A few notes from infra/procurement:
1) Helio would prefer a faster initial on-ramp: Month 1: 200 -> Month 4: 320 -> Month 8: 400, since we have a second product line going live in Q2 and need capacity sooner.
2) We prefer quarterly invoicing that maps to the annual prepay (five equal quarterly invoices per year is not an option — we need four). Can Redwood accept annual prepay split into four invoices per year tied to a contract schedule?
3) For discounts: instead of frontloaded year-by-year increases, we'd prefer a flat annual discount per year but with a credit-back if we exceed the committed TPM by more than 10% in a 3-month window.

I've put our alternative ramp in a sheet (helio-counter-ramp.xlsx) attached. Can you run pricing against our faster ramp and confirm whether the early-ramp bonus is still feasible? Also need to understand if there's flexibility on the early-ramp bonus trigger (95% -> 90%).

-Mark
Mark Saito
VP Infrastructure, HelioHealth
Attachments: helio-counter-ramp.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mark Saito <mark@heliohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased ramp for Dedicated GPUs — finance considerations

Mark/Team —

Thanks for the counter; the faster ramp is doable from a capacity perspective but a couple of finance notes we need to align on before confirming pricing:
- Revenue recognition: For annual prepays split into quarterly invoices we will treat the full prepay as deferred revenue and recognize per the committed schedule unless there is a material change to the committed baselines. Our standard ARR treatment requires a signed schedule that defines the tranche dates.
- Billing flexibility: We can accept the annual prepay split into four invoices, but we need each invoice to reference the master order and include language that the invoice is for the prepay amount for Year N.
- Early-ramp bonus: We are comfortable moving the trigger to 90% achieved within a 3-month rolling window. We will cap the early-ramp bonus at 2% per year and it applies only to the remaining invoice amounts for that year.
- Overages/top-ups: Any capacity purchased above committed amounts will be billed at incremental list rates unless you convert them into an agreed top-up tranche within 30 days.

I'll ask our legal team to prepare an LOI reflecting these commercial guardrails. If that works, Connor can follow up with a consolidated commercial term sheet and a DocuSign link for LOI signature.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Mark Saito <mark@heliohealth.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@heliohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year prepay + phased ramp for Dedicated GPUs — agreed next steps

Mark/Elena —

Thanks — appreciate the alignment. To summarize the agreement in-thread so procurement has everything in one place:
- Term: 3 years, annual prepay (Helio may elect to split into four quarterly invoices per year).
- Ramp: Helio counter: M1 200 -> M4 320 -> M8 400 (baseline and tranche dates to be locked in LOI).
- Discounts: Year 1: 12% (applies to annual prepay baseline), Year 2: 15%, Year 3: 18%. Early-ramp bonus: 2% if Helio reaches >=90% of 12-mo target within any rolling 3-month window; bonus applies to remaining invoices for that year.
- Top-ups/overages: billed at incremental list rate; convertible into a tranche within 30 days for credit toward next-year prepay.
- Finance/legal: Redwood to provide LOI/term sheet and DocuSign link.

Next steps:
1) Legal to share LOI (Aditya) — target Wed 11/25.
2) Helio to review and confirm invoicing preference (annual single invoice vs 4x quarterly invoicing mapped to the prepay).
3) Once LOI is signed: Redwood to provision initial capacity tranche and schedule technical onboarding (we'll set kickoff date after signature).

I'll drop the DocuSign LOI link here as soon as it's ready.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: docuSign-helio-dedicated-LOI.pdf (placeholder link to be sent)
